source_text.Q-1037: GH #2364: CI flake in test/support/service_catalog_reaper_test.exs (concurrent-invocation guard): Postgrex.query!(other_conn, pg_stat_activity ...) raised DBConnection.ConnectionError 'connection not available and request was dropped from queue after 4000ms'. The fake other-invocation connection was a plain Postgrex.start_link with default overload-shedding queue options (queue_target 50ms / queue_interval 2s) and start_link returns before the handshake completes, so on a slow runner the first query is shed. Second class: after GenServer.stop the server backend leaves pg_stat_activity later, so an immediate second sweep can still see the tag.

result.summary: Created Letflow.Test.FakeInvocationConnection (opts/1 = dedicated_connection_opts/0 + parameters application_name; start!/2 starts linked conn, registers ISS-0452 tolerant on_exit stop, bounded poll 100x50ms through the new connection with explicit timeout until its tag is visible; stop_and_wait_gone!/3 stops and polls via Repo.query! until the tag is gone, raising a message naming the tag). Converted 5 sites (service_catalog: concurrent + sibling; template_build: concurrent + sibling; tenant_schema: concurrent); the three second-sweep sites use stop_and_wait_gone!; tenant_schema's private wait_until_gone/2 removed. No lib/ change, no tenant_schema_reaper.ex change. Verification: mix format --check-formatted on 4 files exit 0; mix compile --warnings-as-errors exit 0; MIX_TEST_PARTITION=23 mix test: service_catalog_reaper_test 5 passed (0.2s), template_build_reaper_test 7 passed (0.3s), tenant_schema_reaper_test 6 passed (0.3s). The original flake itself (slow-runner shed) not reproduced locally.
